evidence.description: Report number 23-055997. Lists the date of incident as Wednesday, September 27, 2023, time as not reported, and premises type as residence at the 3600 block of Ocana Avenue, Long Beach, CA.

Responding officer began a scene examination on arrival at the residence. The narrative also states a suspect posed as a salesman or service worker, knocked, and entered when the occupants did not appear to be home, but police say this description applies to every incident in the series and is not specific to this address.
Footage, vehicle, point of entry, damage, and items missing are all recorded as not reported. The OTHER field repeats the series-wide description of the suspect's method.
